recipes.pose: AE / sadness: unmistakably sad drooping brows, downcast eyes and small tear or quivering lips, one hand gently wiping cheek or shoulders slumped. No injury, blood or violence. Not just tired or worried. Props: remove stolen hat; preserve small green/yellow goblin, horn and leaf skirt.

recipes.name: 도깨비
recipes.label: 즐겁게 웃기
recipes.pose: RAK / exuberant enjoyment: clearly laughing with happy narrowed/closed eyes and open smiling mouth, lively joyful welcoming gesture with hands. Visibly stronger and more playful than the quiet closed-mouth joy variant. No motion lines or background effects. Props: remove stolen hat; preserve small green/yellow goblin, horn and leaf skirt.

recipes.name: 일꾼
recipes.label: 화난 표정
recipes.pose: Same bearded laborer, patched tan jacket, brown trousers and headband. Clear fierce controlled anger: deeply furrowed brows, narrowed eyes and tense set mouth, both fists planted at hips in assertive stance. Not worried or begging, no violence. Remove axe/firewood. Preserve full clothing, facial identity and straw shoes.

recipes.name: 막내 선녀
recipes.label: 눈물 닦으며 슬퍼하기
recipes.pose: Same youngest fairy in exact everyday cream long-sleeved jacket and long GREEN skirt with green ribbon and shoes. Clearly sad grieving expression, downcast eyes with small tears, one sleeve gently wiping cheek, other hand relaxed low. Not just determined or thoughtful. Preserve face/hair and ordinary green costume; no white celestial overcoat.

reviewAdjustments: Replaced weakly angry labor protest with a dedicated anger image.
